subject: English
passage: Marine ecologist Mei Santoso works with the coastal community of Tanjung Bay to restore native seagrass meadows that shelter juvenile fish and stabilize the seafloor. In 2018 they decided that designating the bay as a marine protected area would ______ their restoration efforts, because national marine protected areas receive legal safeguards from fishing and dredging that other coastal waters do not.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer because 'promote' most logically completes the text's discussion of the seagrass restoration efforts led by Mei Santoso and the community of Tanjung Bay. In this context, 'promote' means to support or contribute to the success of something. The text explains that designating the bay as a marine protected area would confer legal safeguards from fishing and dredging that other coastal waters do not receive. Because those added protections would help the restoration effort succeed, the designation would promote that effort.
